text.tspan: onboard: SGM6029C buck (BAT → 3V3), Li-ion charger on BAT (blocked by D1),
user LED GPIO15 (active-LOW), RF-switch power GPIO3 (10k pull-up, LOW = on)
SOFT KEYS (4 MX switches, hand-wired, 2 wires)
ROLE STRAP: none on the scoreboard - D7 (EPD DC) reads HIGH with the internal pull-up at boot = scoreboard.
A missing strap therefore falls back to scoreboard, which only READS D3 (no contention with the goal's BEAM_PWR).
SOUND option B: buzzer (R_SND socketed: max-volume knob)
SND = XIAO MTDO back pad (GPIO7), wire pre-soldered.
LEDC square, notes 1–2 kHz, HIGH = coil on.
SOUND option A: speaker (fit ONE option: the 1 kΩ plugs into R_A1 or R_B)
SND = GPIO7 (MTDO pad): I2S0 PDM TX, ONE_LINE_DAC, 16-bit 22.05 kHz × 128 = 2.8 MHz bitstream.
RC poles ≈ 16 kHz. Amp VIN = VSYS (after D1: reverse-protected, powered whenever the MCU is); C_AMP on its pins.
SD HIGH = on (PWM15 full ON); the amp board's SD pull-up REMOVED (else 0.5 mA always).
Amp trim pot or attenuator = max-volume knob; sound_volume = digital gain −18/−9/0 dB. Muted while USB is present.
CARD READER (RFID-RC522 module, 13.56 MHz, power LED removed)
SPI shared with the e-paper (≤ 10 MHz, mode 0); MISO is its own pin
(the MFRC522 doesn't release MISO). RST bridged to 3.3V at the module;
2.8–3.1 V on USB, 0 V on batteries
KEY LEDs (PCA9685 board, I²C 0x40, power LED removed)
common cathode. LED2–4 the same on
Totem-pole, HIGH = on; ≤ 20 mA in total.
4 × MX-style switches, hand-wired. Pressed level < V_IL (0.83 V) → ext1 wake on D2 LOW;
then ADC1_CH2 at 0 dB attenuation tells K1–K4 apart (K1 left … K4 right).
